title: fix(scripts): the swallow census reads its own empty worklist as a landed handover
body:
Fixes #15503

One file, `scripts/measure-durability-swallow-family.mjs` — the #12981
programme's instrument of record, one layer further out than PR #15502 reached.
That PR repaired four stale statements in this file's PROSE; this is the fifth,
and it is in the instrument's own printed READING: the line the tier-1 worklist
prints when it has nothing to print.

## The line, before and after

```
before:     (none — the family is repaired; the gate handover step is unblocked)
after :     (none — the family is repaired; the gate handover step landed in PR #15458, and #12981 closed with PR #15472)
```

The handover is not waiting on anything: PR #15458 declared `tryInsert` /
`tryUpdate` in the gate's `DURABILITY_CRITICAL_CALLEES`, and #12981 closed with
PR #15472. The header above this code has said so since PR #15502; the reading
had not caught up.

## Why nobody caught it, and what this PR does about that

The line is UNREACHABLE on this tree, which is exactly why it went stale under a
green farm — a string no run can print is a string no run can contradict. The
census reaches the row-per-file branch instead:

```
  [1] DARK members, by file — the repair worklist:
    1×  packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts

  DETERMINED, not outstanding                  3 site(s) in 3 file(s)
```

So rewording it alone would have been one unverifiable string traded for
another. The worklist body moves into `worklistLines(outstanding, determined)`
— a producer that takes its population as arguments and reads nothing else —
and `WORKLIST_READING_CONTROLS` hands it populations this tree does not have.
Three rows, asserted in BOTH self-test modes:

| the fixture | what it pins |
|---|---|
| no outstanding member, no DETERMINED row | the reworded line, spelled out in full |
| no outstanding member, register non-empty | `(none outstanding — every DARK member is DETERMINED below, and every one is still a member)` |
| two outstanding members across two files | the file rows, the count column and the by-file sort — and that NEITHER `(none …)` line appears |

The third row is the family's negative leg and is not optional: without a
population that must print work, the two pins above would stay green against a
producer that had stopped consulting its population at all. The table is pinned
to its own length first (#13799's floor recipe). Each expected line is spelled
INDEPENDENTLY of the producer — a control that compared the producer against a
shared constant would pass whatever that constant said.

It is in `gated` by the test `SELF_TEST_MODES` states: can a successful repair
destroy it? No — the empty worklist it pins is the state the repair programme is
trying to reach, so the day this family matters most is the day the programme
succeeds.

⛔ Nothing else in the census moves: member sites, tiers, the existing controls,
the `DETERMINED` register and the gate-vocabulary cross-check (PR #15502) are
untouched.

## The census's own reading does not move

Measured against a second checkout of this branch's fork point, `cf6b67164`,
`pnpm install`ed, so `packages/**` is held byte-identical and this file is the
only variable.

```
diff base.census  branch.census  -> exit 0   # normal mode
diff base.sites   branch.sites   -> exit 0   # --sites
diff base.json    branch.json    -> exit 0   # --json
```

The self-test verdict line does change, by design — it carries the new family's
count:

```
before: … 20 copied gate-vocabulary name(s) match the gate's own declaration, 56 member site(s) total
after : … 20 copied gate-vocabulary name(s) match the gate's own declaration, 3 worklist reading(s)
        print as declared over a fixture population, 56 member site(s) total
```

## Verification

All on the final commit, `5a745b9ca` — no commit lands after this run. Every exit code
captured by redirecting to a file first and reading `$?` before any pipe; each
gate quoted from its own printed verdict line.

- **`node scripts/measure-durability-swallow-family.mjs`** exit 0 on the branch
  and exit 0 on the fork-point checkout, and likewise `--sites` (exit 0 / 0) and
  `--json` (exit 0 / 0). The three `diff`s above are the readings.
- **`--self-test`** exit 0:
  `✓ measure-durability-swallow-family self-test: 4 positive control(s) yield members at their declared tier, 3 negative control(s) yield none, 2 regression control(s) stay clear, 6 resolution control(s) resolve as declared, 3 DETERMINED register row(s) cross-check clean, 20 copied gate-vocabulary name(s) match the gate's own declaration, 3 worklist reading(s) print as declared over a fixture population, 56 member site(s) total`
- **`--self-test=gated`** exit 0, same counts under the gated banner (and this
  is what `pnpm check:swallow-census-controls` runs in CI):
  `✓ measure-durability-swallow-family self-test, gated families (#13919): 3 negative control(s) yield none, 2 regression control(s) stay clear, 6 resolution control(s) resolve as declared, 3 DETERMINED register row(s) cross-check clean, 20 copied gate-vocabulary name(s) match the gate's own declaration, 3 worklist reading(s) print as declared over a fixture population, 56 member site(s) total`
- **The new control is proved able to FAIL, by ablation on the committed
  implementation** — trap-guarded (`trap restore EXIT INT TERM`, absolute paths
  resolved from `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`), reverting the wording in the
  PRODUCER only, never in the control table. No build leg exists or is owed:
  this script is executed by node from source, so there is no `dist/` between
  the edit and the run.
  - the mutation is confirmed ON DISK before the run, by counting both markers
    and by the blob: producer-with-new-wording 1 → 0, producer-with-old-wording
    0 → 1, blob `a098c0b3…` → `cf8d8eae…`;
  - `--self-test` exit **1** and `--self-test=gated` exit **1**, and only the new
    family fires:

    ```
    x  measure-durability-swallow-family self-test FAILED

      - the worklist's reading moved: no outstanding member and no DETERMINED row — the programme has finished
          declared: |    (none — the family is repaired; the gate handover step landed in PR #15458, and #12981 closed with PR #15472)|
          printed:  |    (none — the family is repaired; the gate handover step is unblocked)|
    ```

    That `printed:` line is also the reachability evidence: the fixture really
    does drive the branch this tree cannot reach.
  - the restore is proved BY STATE, not by an exit code: restored blob
    `a098c0b3a6ebeec042886f6c0031e0796ac58c68` equals the HEAD blob,
    `git diff HEAD` for that path is empty, and the marker counts are back at
    1 / 0.
- **`pnpm check:durability-log-level`** exit 0 — the sibling gate is untouched
  and unchanged by this diff:

  ```
  ✓ durability-degradation log levels: 29 durability-critical catch seam(s), all
    loud, rethrowing or propagating to the caller (4 propagating, declared);
    2 counter-guarded summary report(s) outside a catch, all of them able to
    print against a sink with no `error` (#9748).
  ```
- **Derived gate family** — `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands
  --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, no paths passed (it read the change set
  itself, `1 path(s) vs merge base cf6b67164`): **25 commands, every one run,
  all exit 0.** Including `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` —
  `✓ dispatch-gates self-test: 1415 cases pass.` (no case edited),
  `pnpm check:swallow-census-controls` (the gated leg above),
  `pnpm check:nul-bytes` —
  `check-nul-bytes: OK (scanned 7530 text file(s) -- 7530 tracked, 0 untracked-not-ignored; skipped 7 binary; no raw ASCII control bytes).`, and
  `node scripts/check-self-test-wired.mjs` —
  `✓ check-self-test-wired: every one of the 170 script(s) CI runs that ship a --self-test has that self-test run by CI.`
- **The six artifact-roster gates whose roster sits under `scripts/`** — the
  ones the derivation flags as "silence is not evidence in EITHER direction" —
  were run rather than reasoned about: `check-published-list-mirrors.mjs` and
  its `--self-test`, `check:console-injection`, `check:engine-double-contract`,
  `check:i18n-stale-fill` all exit 0. `check:published-readme-exports` is **NOT
  MEASURED**: it needs a built tree and this worktree has never been built, so
  it exits 1 naming missing `dist/**` type entries in packages this diff does
  not touch (`Build first: pnpm build`) — a prerequisite failure, recorded as
  such and never as a pass or a red.
- **Whole-repo `pnpm lint`** (`eslint . --no-inline-config`) exit 0, run in full
  under this container's shared verify lock —
  `os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0 · held the lock 84s (1m24s) · waited 71s (1m11s)`.
  No narrowing, so no narrowing evidence is owed. (An earlier attempt at the
  gate batch returned the wrapper's exit **99**, `never acquired` — that is NOT
  MEASURED, and nothing above is quoted from it; every reading here comes from a
  run that acquired.)
- **Control-byte self-scan** of the edited file
  (`grep -naP '[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f\x7f]'`): no hits (exit 1).
- **No test file is owed by this diff and none exists to re-run**: the edited
  script has no `*.test.*` suite anywhere in the tree — its assertions are its
  own `--self-test`, run above in both modes, which is what gained a family.

## Changeset

`skip-changeset`: the diff is `scripts/**` only and publishes nothing from any
released package.

## Not done here

Not flipped to ready, no auto-merge — the PM reviews first. One finding noticed
on the way out is filed rather than ridden along: #15569 (the `lint.yml` step
comment that annotates this instrument still counts four control families and
says `gated` runs three).
